<!-- ====== Robot AI Agent Widget (Copy-Paste Ready) ====== -->
<style>
  .robot-widget {
    position: fixed;
    bottom: 20px;
    right: 20px;
    width: 80px;
    height: 80px;
    cursor: pointer;
    z-index: 9999;
    animation: robotFloat 2.5s ease-in-out infinite;
  }
  .robot-widget img {
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
    object-fit: contain;
    filter: drop-shadow(0 6px 10px rgba(0,0,0,0.25));
  }
  @keyframes robotFloat {
    0%   { transform: translateY(0px); }
    50%  { transform: translateY(-10px); }
    100% { transform: translateY(0px); }
  }

  .chat-window {
    position: fixed;
    bottom: 110px;
    right: 20px;
    width: 300px;
    height: 380px;
    background: #ffffff;
    border-radius: 16px;
    box-shadow: 0 8px 24px rgba(0,0,0,0.25);
    display: none;
    flex-direction: column;
    overflow: hidden;
    z-index: 9999;
    font-family: Arial, sans-serif;
  }
  .chat-window.show { display: flex; }

  .chat-header {
    background: #2a9fd6;
    color: #fff;
    padding: 12px;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 8px;
    font-weight: bold;
  }
  .chat-header img {
    width: 32px; height: 32px; object-fit: contain;
  }
  .chat-header .close-btn {
    margin-left: auto;
    cursor: pointer;
    font-size: 18px;
  }

  .chat-body {
    flex: 1;
    padding: 10px;
    overflow-y: auto;
    background: #f4f6f8;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 8px;
  }

  .msg {
    max-width: 75%;
    padding: 8px 12px;
    border-radius: 12px;
    font-size: 13px;
    line-height: 1.4;
  }
  .msg.bot {
    background: #e3f2fd;
    align-self: flex-start;
    border-bottom-left-radius: 2px;
  }
  .msg.user {
    background: #2a9fd6;
    color: #fff;
    align-self: flex-end;
    border-bottom-right-radius: 2px;
  }

  .chat-input {
    display: flex;
    border-top: 1px solid #ddd;
  }
  .chat-input input {
    flex: 1;
    border: none;
    padding: 10px;
    font-size: 13px;
    outline: none;
  }
  .chat-input button {
    background: #2a9fd6;
    color: #fff;
    border: none;
    padding: 0 16px;
    cursor: pointer;
    font-size: 13px;
  }
</style>

<div class="chat-window" id="chatWindow">
  <div class="chat-header">
    <img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Bot">
    Assistant
    <span class="close-btn" onclick="toggleChat(false)">&times;</span>
  </div>
  <div class="chat-body" id="chatBody">
    <div class="msg bot">Hi! Main aap ka assistant hoon. Kuch poochna hai?</div>
  </div>
  <div class="chat-input">
    <input type="text" id="chatInput" placeholder="Apna sawal likhein..." onkeypress="if(event.key==='Enter') sendMessage()">
    <button onclick="sendMessage()">Send</button>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="robot-widget" onclick="toggleChat()">
  <img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Assistant Bot">
</div>

<script>
  function toggleChat(forceState) {
    const win = document.getElementById('chatWindow');
    if (typeof forceState === 'boolean') {
      win.classList.toggle('show', forceState);
    } else {
      win.classList.toggle('show');
    }
  }

  // Simple rule-based replies -- yahan apni marzi ke rules/keywords add kar sakte hain
  function getBotReply(userText) {
    const text = userText.toLowerCase();
    if (text.includes('hello') || text.includes('hi') || text.includes('salam')) {
      return "Assalam-o-Alaikum! Kaise madad kar sakta hoon?";
    } else if (text.includes('price') || text.includes('qeemat')) {
      return "Hamare packages ki details ke liye humein contact karein.";
    } else if (text.includes('contact') || text.includes('number')) {
      return "Aap humein email ya contact form se rabta kar sakte hain.";
    } else if (text.includes('thanks') || text.includes('shukriya')) {
      return "Khushi hui madad kar ke! Aur kuch chahiye?";
    } else {
      return "Sorry, mujhe abhi is baare mein maloomat nahi. Please rephrase karein ya humari team se contact karein.";
    }
  }

  function sendMessage() {
    const input = document.getElementById('chatInput');
    const text = input.value.trim();
    if (!text) return;

    const body = document.getElementById('chatBody');

    const userMsg = document.createElement('div');
    userMsg.className = 'msg user';
    userMsg.textContent = text;
    body.appendChild(userMsg);

    input.value = '';

    setTimeout(() => {
      const botMsg = document.createElement('div');
      botMsg.className = 'msg bot';
      botMsg.textContent = getBotReply(text);
      body.appendChild(botMsg);
      body.scrollTop = body.scrollHeight;
    }, 500);

    body.scrollTop = body.scrollHeight;
  }
</script>
<!-- ====== End Robot AI Agent Widget ====== -->
